title: Who Keeps a Bubble Alive? Skin in the Game and the Survival of Rational Bubbles
abstract: arXiv:2610.19496v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: We study how retained ownership supports the value of an asset that pays no dividends and is held only for resale. A sponsor chooses hidden maintenance that determines market survival, bears its full cost, and captures only the benefit accruing to its retained tokens. A positive stationary equilibrium exists if and only if retention meets an endogenous minimum. Under additional curvature restrictions, retention above this threshold supports two positive stationary equilibria. Conditional on survival, prices below the upper equilibrium converge to the lower one while the upper price is the largest feasible initial valuation. Greater retention expands the feasible price interval. Credible news that future retention will be below the minimum causes an immediate collapse through backward unraveling. The model identifies a governance channel through which insider unlocks can affect valuation without changing total token supply or fundamental

translated_title: 谁在维持泡沫？利益绑定与理性泡沫的存续
translated_abstract: 我们研究了留存所有权如何支撑一项不支付股息、仅为转售而持有的资产的价值。发起人选择决定市场存续的隐藏性维护行为，承担其全部成本，但只获取其留存代币所产生的收益。当且仅当留存比例满足一个内生最小值时，正向稳态均衡才存在。在额外的曲率限制条件下，高于该阈值的留存比例可以支持两个正向稳态均衡。在市场存续的条件下，低于上均衡的价格会收敛到下均衡，而上均衡价格是可行的最大初始估值。更大的留存比例会扩大可行的价格区间。当出现关于未来留存将低于最小值的可信消息时，市场会通过逆向解绑立即崩溃。该模型识别出一个治理渠道：内部人解禁可以在不改变代币总供应量或基本面的情况下影响估值。
tldr: 该论文构建模型证明，发起人留存代币比例必须超过一个内生最小值才能维持无股息资产的理性泡沫存续，而内部人解禁若使留存低于该阈值，将通过逆向解绑导致价格立即崩溃。
en_tdlr: The paper shows that a sponsor's token retention must exceed an endogenous minimum to sustain a rational bubble on a dividend-free asset, and credible news of insider unlocks pushing retention below this threshold triggers an immediate price collapse.
